notes.title: Game Update v5.0.3
notes.notes: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Civil War: 1864 - version 4.1.2 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Change: The bonus 'To War!' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.
[/list]

notes.title: Civil War: 1864 Version 4.1.1 Update
notes.notes: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Civil War: 1864 v4.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Change: A reduction in the download size.
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Change: Improved map zoom.
[*] Change: When a general ends alone in a hex adjacent to an enemy, after enemy shooting, it now evades if possible, or is destroyed.
[*] Change: Updated the combat capabilities of Cavalry armed only with Pistols.
[*] Fix: A rare crash which could occur after charging.
[*] Fix: A critical issue displaying the curved loss meters after the previous graphics update.
[*] Fix: An error preventing the 'Game Updates' text from appearing.
[*] Fix: An issue that could prevent the game from loading.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount dismount button options.
[*] Fix: Some line of sight issues from high hill hexes across lower hill hexes.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Some time flank attacks provided no benefit in combat.
[*] Fix: Some units were not getting their shock combat bonus in a charge combat.
[*] Fix: Units may sometimes have been unable to attack adjacent enemy huts or tents unless charging.
[/list]

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've just patched "Civil War: 1864" to address the issue Windows users were having with AI turns hanging.  Apologies for the inconvenience this must have caused in the meantime!  We hope everyone is enjoying the game, but if there's any suggestions or issues anyone is experiencing, please just let us know at support@hexwar.com.

~ The HexWar Games Team.
